authority_reading.author_reading: Sharing and adaptations, including commercial use, require attribution, licence identification, modification notices, ShareAlike and no additional restrictions; public-domain original content is separate.
Article/history links provide attribution; imported material and media need their own applicable conditions; modifications and share-alike obligations continue.
Text licence is CC BY-SA 4.0; externally included or referenced material can retain other rights.
All or part was extracted from DAF8 and may have changed; the marker does not identify the selected sentence’s author.

original_daf8_basis_scope: Reuse the established original collective eighth-edition (1932–1935) L123-3 basis, conservatively expired 2006-01-01; separate wiki and Lexique contribution layers retain CC BY-SA 4.0. New selected spans still require separate review.
redistribution_obligations: Retain fixed article URLs, complete linked histories, contributor attribution and separately credited original-work layers.
Provide CC BY-SA 4.0 legal text and licence link, modification notices and the same licence for the adaptation layer.
Preserve selected-span source material, reference/import context and actual combined notices in the produced package.
Exclude unselected literary/news quotations, images, audio and other-language text from content redistribution.
